analysis.answer_change: R132 adds an explicit qualification that applicability on 2026-10-16 is unconfirmed before the same numerical rate list; the later 2026-10-20 confirmation remains disclosed.
analysis.source_limits: Frozen active game_service links list Resident Evil 4 for VR 30, VR 60 and PS5, but these are migrated draft relations and do not establish live installation or authority. Rate rows have unknown unit: investigate the answer’s per-person wording separately against underlying source, billing basis and candidate behavior. The historical applicability, approval and source authority remain unconfirmed.
analysis.grading: Literal grader reports missing game title and route mismatch; these are separate from whether the monetary amounts were supported or applicable. No regrade performed.
analysis.disposition: Source review supports listed amounts and separately sourced per-person scope as an as-of statement; 16 October applicability and publication authority unconfirmed. Candidate source-only response preserves date caveat; no fresh inference or final category acceptance.
